decisions.Kwic: 一棒施行該百令，銅頭鐵額血淋身

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Jie Weizhou (介為舟禪師語錄): entering his room for a private interview session, Jie Weizhou says that one enacted staff-blow encompasses a hundred commands and leaves copper heads and iron foreheads streaming blood.
